फा. सं. 10-7/2023-वी.सी आई.---भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा परिषद अधिनियम,1984 (1984 का 52) 
की धारा 23 की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण मे भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा परिषद से भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा 
व्यवसायी रजिस्टर बनाए रखने की अपेक्षा की गई है जिसमे उस सभी व्यकितयो के नाम अतर्विष्ट होगे जो कि 
मान्यता पशु चिकित्सा अर्हता धारण करते है और उस राज्य/संध कि पशु चिकित्सा के पास तत्समय 
नामावलीगत है जिस पर अधिनियम का विस्तार है। 


सचिव भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा परिषद, भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा परिषद अधिनियम, 1984 (1984 का 
52) की धारा 23 की उपधारा (2) दुबारा प्रवृत शाक्तियो का प्रयोग करते हुए निर्देश देते है कि भारतीय पशु 
चिकित्सा व्यवसायी रजिस्टर, 2023 का अनुपूरक साधारण जानकारी के लिए प्रकाशित किया जाए।

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 1st December, 2023 
9.0. 5131(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. 3125 Dated:13.07.2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation for 


Ludhiyana-Barnala-Bathinda Greendfield Highway of NH754AD on the stretch of land from Km 34 to Km 64 in the 
district of Barnala in the state of Punjab. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan Times” and “Ajit” both 
dated 16.07.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the District Revenue Officer 
Barnala has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the District Revenue Officer Barnala and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the 
land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

9.0. 527(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 43(E) Dated:0/03/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction (four laning), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH727A(Deoria Bypass) in the stretch of land from Km. 26.78 to Km. 49.045 in the district of DEORIA in the 
state of UTTAR PRADESH; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Amar Ujala(HIndi)” and 
“Hindustan Times(English)” both dated 07 April,2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


80 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3485(अ) तारीख 03/08/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के देवरिया जिले में NH-727B 
(नवलपुर-सिकंदरपुर) के कि.मी. 61.500 से कि.मी. 106.800 के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण/चौडीकरण(2-लेन व 4-लेन Yor 
शोल्डर सहित का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट 
भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "31 अगस्त, 
2023 " को "दैनिक जागरण (हिंदी)" और "इंडियन एक्सप्रेस (अंग्रेजी)" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 1st December, 2023 


S.O. 5132(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 3485(E) Dated:03/08/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction (widening two/four laning with paved shoulder etc), 
maintenance,management and operation of NH-727B (Nawalpur-Sikandarpur) from Km. 61.500 to Km 106.800 in the 
district of Deoria in the state of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Jagran(Hindi)” and 
“Indian Express(English)” both dated "3/7 August, 2023" under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
